subject: Brief for C-suite: outcomes, risks, and procurement path
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.t@medihealth.com>, Rajesh Patel <r.patel@medihealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Brief for C-suite: outcomes, risks, and procurement path

Hi Sara / Rajesh —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation I wanted to capture the high-level business outcomes you and your execs care about, the main technical and procurement risks we identified, and the proposed next steps for the leadership review. Please treat this note as the one-page brief you can circulate to the CFO/CTO team.

1) Business outcomes (priority order)
- Reduce per-transaction inference cost for clinical note generation by ~60% vs. current hosted baseline while maintaining fidelity to clinical templates.
- Move from pilot to 3-region production for the oncology workflows within 6 months.
- Demonstrate a 30% reduction in clinician review time on generated summaries in the POC.

2) Key pain points discussed
- Current vendor latency spikes during batch imports (spikes impacting overnight processing).
- Unclear audit trail for PHI-handling; compliance team needs KMS + INGRESS/EGRESS logs.
- Procurement prefers a fixed monthly committed capacity option, not purely consumption-based for the hospital network.

3) Risks we flagged (for leadership):
- Procurement timeline risk: MediHealth legal will require a 60-day review of security artifacts (SOC2 + encryption attestations).
- Operational risk: non-deterministic latency under peak loads unless we implement prefix caching and pre-warmed Dedicated nodes.
- Data residency risk for EU patients routed to US regions; needs routing policy and contractual assurances.

4) Proposed procurement path (recommended)
- Short term: 6-week POC on Dedicated capacity (reserved pool) scoped to oncology batch jobs + streaming API for realtime triage.
- Contracting: NDA completed; provide SOC2 and KMS integration docs now. Aim to have SOW + pricing term sheet signed within 30 days post-POC.
- Commercial: Offer a discounted committed monthly rate for the first 6 months with usage true-up to smooth their internal chargeback.

5) Action owners and immediate next steps
- Markus (me): Deliver Risk Matrix + Mutual Action Plan by EOD tomorrow (attached).
- Lauren: Prepare short deck for CFO focused on cost delta, SLOs, and procurement options (due Fri).
- Karthik: Pull initial trial topology and expected GPU footprint for Dedicated nodes (due next Tue).
- Sara / Rajesh: Confirm internal exec availability for a 30-min CFO/CTO alignment call next week.

Attachments: MediHealth_RiskMatrix_v1.pdf, MediHealth_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx, POC_Scope_Summary.docx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the documents and a proposed calendar invite once I hear availability.

Best,
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

Markus — thanks for the crisp summary. This is exactly what leadership asked for. Two quick clarifications: 

1) The 60-day legal review is our baseline; if you can provide the KMS integration and encryption attestations up front it may shorten formal review to ~30 days.
2) For the POC scope, can you confirm we can limit residency for EU patient records to our EU nexus region during the trial? That is a gate for our privacy office.

We are available for a 30-min alignment call next Wed (07/21) at 10:00am ET. I’ll loop in our CFO once you provide the one-slide summary.
